newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens forms electical venture with OEG Japan.
newsitem.headline: Siemens forms electical venture with OEG Japan.

text.p: German conglomerate Siemens AG said on Monday it formed a joint venture with Original Electromechanical Japan Co. Ltd in an effort to boost Asian sales of electrical devices.

Each partner would own 50 percent of the new company, called OEG Ltd, Siemens said. Siemens' Japanese partner would contribute subsidiaries in Taiwan, China, Hong Kong and Singapore that produce relays, devices used in almost all kinds of electrical equipment.
In 1996 Original Electromechanical had 2,900 employees and revenue of 140 million marks, with 90 percent of its sales in Asia.

Siemens' Electromechanical Components (EC) unit, with 6,800 employees, had sales of 1.3 billion marks and pretax profit of 34 million marks last year. It had first-quarter sales of 300 million marks. Siemens said it is the world's second-largest maker of relays.
